name: Calculus 2: accumulation
description: Accumulation, areas and volumes, integration techniques, infinite series and Taylor series, taught at the Kepler outpost.
about:
Calculus 2 realm ("Calculus 2: accumulation"): accumulation, areas, volumes, techniques of integration, infinite
series and Taylor series, for an adult who has finished Calculus 1 and nothing more. Same Kepler outpost, now building to
last, and Mira is still the mentor. The concept plan is docs/plans/CALC2-PLAN.md.

chapters.name: Accumulation
chapters.blurb: Totals from rates, and the substitution that undoes the chain rule.

sector.name: Reservoir
sector.purpose: keep count of everything that flows in and out

chapters.name: Areas and solids
chapters.blurb: Areas between curves and volumes built from slices.

sector.name: Hull Foundry
sector.purpose: cut and shape the plates and tanks we build

chapters.name: Length, work and balance
chapters.blurb: Shells, lengths of curves, the work of a varying force and where a shape balances.

sector.name: Cargo Crane
sector.purpose: lift, measure and balance heavy loads

chapters.name: Techniques of integration
chapters.blurb: By parts, trigonometric tricks, partial fractions and good numerical estimates.

sector.name: Computing Core
sector.purpose: turn hard integrals into ones we can do

chapters.name: Growth and the infinite
chapters.blurb: Integrals over endless intervals, decay, and lists of numbers that settle down.

sector.name: Deep Signal Array
sector.purpose: add up quantities that never end

chapters.name: Testing series
chapters.blurb: Tests that decide whether a series converges, and how far off a partial sum is.

sector.name: Signal Lab
sector.purpose: know when an endless sum settles

chapters.name: Power series
chapters.blurb: Taylor series, their errors, and a first look at paths given by two functions.

sector.name: Navigation Room
sector.purpose: replace hard functions with polynomials we can compute

mentor.name: Mira
mentor.opening: I’m Mira. Everything here is built to last now, and we have to {purpose}. Your task is “{title}.” {brief} The idea we need: {topic}.
mentor.closing: You already have the derivatives and the first integrals from Calculus 1. I’ll go through the worked example with you, and the guided steps are there whenever you want them.

copy.homeEyebrow: THE OUTPOST IS BUILDING TO LAST
copy.homeTitle:
Everything here adds up.
Learn to measure the whole.
copy.firstVisit: Welcome back. The reservoir is open, and now we have to know exactly how much flows in, how much the domes hold and how far the signals reach. We start with one tank and a rate you already know how to integrate.
copy.allDone: You did it. Every tank, crane and signal at the outpost is measured, and endless sums no longer scare you. Calculus 3 begins on the survey deck, where everything has three directions.
copy.chaptersNote: Seven chapters. Learn every concept in a chapter to unlock a landmark for the outpost. Practice missions are optional.

skills.title: The skill tree
skills.text: Follow the prerequisite branches from accumulation to infinite series. Each mission you finish opens the ideas built on it.

visual.title: The concept bench
visual.text: Pick any mission, change its numbers and predict the result before you check it. Nothing here affects your progress, and it all works offline.

help.title: Accumulation, measured.
help.intro: Calculus 2 starts where Calculus 1 ends, with the definite integral and the Fundamental Theorem. It then adds areas, volumes, work, techniques of integration, infinite sums and Taylor series. Every new word and symbol is explained before you are asked to use it, with a worked example first.
help.answers: Angles are in radians throughout; a volume with π asks for k in k·π, and a convergence question asks for 1 or 0, then a number.
